flag_bedside.label: Flags every bedside X-ray, looks at no picture

metadata_only.label: Logistic regression on view, age and sex (no picture), trained on the adult training X-rays

frozen_imagenet.label: Frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 + logistic regression, trained on the adult training X-rays

xray_pretrained_as_is.label: EXPLORATORY: public network trained on chest X-rays of another hospital (CheXpert), used as published

xray_pretrained_frozen.label: EXPLORATORY: the same network + logistic regression trained on the adult training X-rays

primary_comparison.what: adult test AUROC (lung opacity vs everything else), v2_kids_plus_all minus published kids_plus_adults, patients resampled 1000 times
primary_comparison.rule: called better only if the overall interval lies above zero and the difference is positive inside both views

note: Test results. Thresholds come from validation X-rays only (docs/V2_PROTOCOL.md). 'Lung opacity' is a radiologist's finding, not a confirmed pneumonia. Seeds: range of the runs, not a confidence interval.
